description: This file defines a C# class 'FilteredImplicitSubscriptionGrain' that implements an Orleans grain with implicit stream subscription, handling stream events and maintaining counters per stream namespace.

classes.name: FilteredImplicitSubscriptionGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class that subscribes to streams with implicit subscription attribute, maintains counters for each stream namespace, and provides a method to retrieve counters.

methods.name: FilteredImplicitSubscriptionGrain
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logger using the provided ILoggerFactory.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous override method called upon grain activation; sets up stream subscriptions and initializes counters.

methods.name: GetCounter
methods.description: Returns the current count of events received for a given stream namespace.
